headline: A quick kick from the Colts
what_happened: The Colts decided to punt, which means they kicked the ball away to give KC possession instead of trying for a fourth down play.
who: R.Sanchez kicked the ball and N.Remigio caught it for KC.
why_it_matters: This is great news for our Chiefs! Since the Colts chose to punt instead of going for it on fourth down, their chances of winning dropped significantly, keeping the game tied.
